Paragraph: Sugreeva rejoicingly said to Raghava, "you are the amiable friend of mine, henceforth our mirth or miseries are same for us..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Defining the terms of true friendship based on shared destiny.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva declares that their joys and sorrows are now shared equally.
Outcome/Resolution: Complete emotional and operational alignment between allies.
